title: A gate log keeps failure lines of any length
what: The failure lines a gate copies into its committed gate log are cut to at most 300 characters each (with a mark that the line was cut), as they are already limited by count.
why: 26 Oct night, found by the review of the checks-artifacts design (F10) and counted from git: bin/ci limits failure lines by count but not by length; one gate log already in .relay/checks holds a 61,667-character line. A committed log stays in history forever and may carry whatever a test printed. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A gate whose failing step prints one 70,000-character line: the committed gate log holds the whole line.
pass_cases: The same gate log holds the line cut to 300 characters with a cut mark; short failure lines are unchanged; the count limit still holds.
where: bin/ci (failure lines copied into the gate log, bin/ci:27)

fact: Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)
